spec.description: Privilege escalation and account changes, from the sudo, su and shadow-utils journal.

spec.title: Sudo commands
spec.description: Commands run through `sudo`, excluding the accounts listed in the **Service accounts** variable.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Sudo commands
spec.description: Service accounts are on the Service tab.

spec.expr: sum by (user, target) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` | regexp `USER=(?P<target>\S+) ;` [$__interval]))

spec.description:
One row per account, target account, binary and host; arguments are stripped.
- Service accounts are on the Service tab.
- A `sudo` run inside another `sudo` session is recorded under the account that session became, so it can show `root` or a service account's target as the caller.

spec.expr: sum by (key, user, target, cmd, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` | regexp `USER=(?P<target>\S+) ;` | regexp `COMMAND=(?P<cmd>\S+)` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.target}} · {{.cmd}} · {{.hostname}}` [$__range]))

max by (key) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` | regexp `USER=(?P<target>\S+) ;` | regexp `COMMAND=(?P<cmd>\S+)` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.target}} · {{.cmd}} · {{.hostname}}` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

spec.title: Service
spec.description: `sudo` by the accounts listed in the **Service accounts** variable.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user =~ `^($service)$` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Failures
spec.description: A wrong password is counted twice: once as a PAM failure when it is typed, and again when the tool gives up — as `incorrect password` under `sudo`, as `denied` under `su`.

spec.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` ; TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : (?P<reason>[^;]+) ; TTY=` | reason != `` | label_format reason=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^account validation failure, is your account locked[?]$" (regexReplaceAll "^sorry, you must have a tty to run sudo$" (regexReplaceAll "^[0-9]+ incorrect password attempts?$" .reason "incorrect password") "must have a tty") "account validation failure" }}` [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `:auth\): (authentication failure|auth could not identify password)` | regexp `(?:logname=|password for \[)(?P<user>[^ \]]+)` [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `:auth\): (authentication failure|auth could not identify password)` | regexp `(?:logname=|password for \[)(?P<user>[^ \]]+)` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^FAILED SU ` | regexp `^FAILED SU \(to (?P<target>\S+)\) (?P<user>\S+) on ` [$__interval]))

spec.description:
One row per account, reason and host, service accounts included, capped at the top 1000.
- `Reason` has the classes of the chart above.
- An account of `-` is a PAM failure that named none.
- sudo-rs hosts log no `sudo` refusals.

spec.expr: topk(1000, sum by (key, user, reason, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sudo|su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `( : [^;]+ ; TTY=|:auth\): (authentication failure|auth could not identify password)|^FAILED SU )` | regexp `^\s*(?P<ruser>\S+) : (?P<reason>[^;]+) ; TTY=` | regexp `(?:logname=|password for \[)(?P<puser>[^ \]]+)` | regexp `^FAILED SU \(to (?P<target>\S+)\) (?P<suser>\S+) on ` | label_format user=`{{ or .ruser .puser .suser "-" }}`, reason=`{{ if .suser }}su · denied{{ else if .reason }}sudo · {{ regexReplaceAll "^account validation failure, is your account locked[?]$" (regexReplaceAll "^sorry, you must have a tty to run sudo$" (regexReplaceAll "^[0-9]+ incorrect password attempts?$" .reason "incorrect password") "must have a tty") "account validation failure" }}{{ else }}{{ .syslog_id }} · PAM auth failure{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.reason}} · {{.hostname}}` [$__range])))

max by (key) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sudo|su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `( : [^;]+ ; TTY=|:auth\): (authentication failure|auth could not identify password)|^FAILED SU )` | regexp `^\s*(?P<ruser>\S+) : (?P<reason>[^;]+) ; TTY=` | regexp `(?:logname=|password for \[)(?P<puser>[^ \]]+)` | regexp `^FAILED SU \(to (?P<target>\S+)\) (?P<suser>\S+) on ` | label_format user=`{{ or .ruser .puser .suser "-" }}`, reason=`{{ if .suser }}su · denied{{ else if .reason }}sudo · {{ regexReplaceAll "^account validation failure, is your account locked[?]$" (regexReplaceAll "^sorry, you must have a tty to run sudo$" (regexReplaceAll "^[0-9]+ incorrect password attempts?$" .reason "incorrect password") "must have a tty") "account validation failure" }}{{ else }}{{ .syslog_id }} · PAM auth failure{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.reason}} · {{.hostname}}` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000 and on (key) topk(1000, sum by (key, user, reason, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sudo|su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `( : [^;]+ ; TTY=|:auth\): (authentication failure|auth could not identify password)|^FAILED SU )` | regexp `^\s*(?P<ruser>\S+) : (?P<reason>[^;]+) ; TTY=` | regexp `(?:logname=|password for \[)(?P<puser>[^ \]]+)` | regexp `^FAILED SU \(to (?P<target>\S+)\) (?P<suser>\S+) on ` | label_format user=`{{ or .ruser .puser .suser "-" }}`, reason=`{{ if .suser }}su · denied{{ else if .reason }}sudo · {{ regexReplaceAll "^account validation failure, is your account locked[?]$" (regexReplaceAll "^sorry, you must have a tty to run sudo$" (regexReplaceAll "^[0-9]+ incorrect password attempts?$" .reason "incorrect password") "must have a tty") "account validation failure" }}{{ else }}{{ .syslog_id }} · PAM auth failure{{ end }}` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.reason}} · {{.hostname}}` [$__range])))

spec.title: Users
spec.description: Distinct accounts that ran a command through `sudo`, service accounts excluded.

spec.expr: count(count by (user) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

sum by (user, target) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user =~ `^($service)$` | regexp `USER=(?P<target>\S+) ;` [$__interval]))

spec.description: One row per service account, target account and host.

spec.expr: sum by (key, user, target, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user =~ `^($service)$` | regexp `USER=(?P<target>\S+) ;` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.target}} · {{.hostname}}` [$__range]))

max by (key) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user =~ `^($service)$` | regexp `USER=(?P<target>\S+) ;` | label_format key=`{{.user}} · {{.target}} · {{.hostname}}` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

spec.title: Hosts
spec.description: Hosts where a person's account ran a command through `sudo`.

spec.expr: count(count by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

spec.description: A user or group created, changed or removed, one per change.

spec.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"useradd|userdel|usermod|groupadd|groupdel|groupmod|gpasswd|passwd|chage|chpasswd|newusers|chsh|chfn"} |~ `$regexp` !~ `(shadow group|group added to /etc/|removed from /etc/|changed in /etc/gshadow|pam_unix\(passwd:|incorrect password|can't |Cannot determine|failed adding)` | label_format class=`{{ if or (eq .syslog_id "useradd") (eq .syslog_id "groupadd") (eq .syslog_id "newusers") }}created{{ else if or (eq .syslog_id "userdel") (eq .syslog_id "groupdel") }}removed{{ else }}changed{{ end }}` [$__interval]))

spec.description: One row per change, with the hosts it was made on. A change whose line names a per-host value, such as a UID, takes one row per value. Only `gpasswd` and `passwd` name the account that made it.

spec.expr: count by (key, syslog_id, msg, hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"useradd|userdel|usermod|groupadd|groupdel|groupmod|gpasswd|passwd|chage|chpasswd|newusers|chsh|chfn"} |~ `$regexp` !~ `(shadow group|group added to /etc/|removed from /etc/|changed in /etc/gshadow|pam_unix\(passwd:|incorrect password|can't |Cannot determine|failed adding)` | label_format key=`{{.syslog_id}} · {{__line__}}`, msg=`{{__line__}}` [$__range]))

max by (key) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"useradd|userdel|usermod|groupadd|groupdel|groupmod|gpasswd|passwd|chage|chpasswd|newusers|chsh|chfn"} |~ `$regexp` !~ `(shadow group|group added to /etc/|removed from /etc/|changed in /etc/gshadow|pam_unix\(passwd:|incorrect password|can't |Cannot determine|failed adding)` | label_format key=`{{.syslog_id}} · {{__line__}}`, msg=`{{__line__}}` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

spec.title: Denied
spec.description:
`sudo` refusals — not in sudoers, command not allowed, no tty, a locked account, a wrong password.

sudo-rs prints refusals to the terminal and logs nothing, so hosts running it are missing from this count.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` ; TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : (?P<reason>[^;]+) ; TTY=` | reason != `` | label_format reason=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^account validation failure, is your account locked[?]$" (regexReplaceAll "^sorry, you must have a tty to run sudo$" (regexReplaceAll "^[0-9]+ incorrect password attempts?$" .reason "incorrect password") "must have a tty") "account validation failure" }}` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.description: One row per host with privilege activity. **Users**, **Commands** and **Last** cover people's accounts, **Service** the rest; **Denied**, **Password** and **su** count every account.

spec.expr: sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__range]))
sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user =~ `^($service)$` [$__range]))
count by (hostname) (count by (hostname, user) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` [$__range])))

sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` ; TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : (?P<reason>[^;]+) ; TTY=` | reason != `` | label_format reason=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^account validation failure, is your account locked[?]$" (regexReplaceAll "^sorry, you must have a tty to run sudo$" (regexReplaceAll "^[0-9]+ incorrect password attempts?$" .reason "incorrect password") "must have a tty") "account validation failure" }}` [$__range]))

sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sudo|su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `:auth\): (authentication failure|auth could not identify password)` | regexp `(?:logname=|password for \[)(?P<user>[^ \]]+)` [$__range]))
sum by (hostname) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^\(to ` | regexp `^\(to (?P<target>\S+)\) (?P<user>\S+) on ` [$__range]))

max by (hostname) (max_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="sudo"} |~ `$regexp` |~ ` : TTY=` | regexp `^\s*(?P<user>\S+) : ` | user !~ `^($service)$` | label_format ts=`{{__timestamp__ | unixEpoch}}` | unwrap ts [$__range])) * 1000

spec.title: Auth failures
spec.description: PAM password failures under `sudo` or `su`, service accounts included.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sudo|su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `:auth\): (authentication failure|auth could not identify password)` | regexp `(?:logname=|password for \[)(?P<user>[^ \]]+)` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

sum by (level) (count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sudo|su|useradd|userdel|usermod|groupadd|groupdel|groupmod|gpasswd|passwd|chage|chpasswd|newusers|chsh|chfn"} |~ `$regexp` !~ `$sessions` !~ `$noservice` | label_format level=`{{ if or (contains " ; TTY=" __line__) (contains "authentication failure" __line__) (contains "could not identify password" __line__) (hasPrefix "FAILED SU" __line__) }}error{{ else if or (contains "COMMAND=" __line__) (hasPrefix "(to " __line__) }}info{{ else if and (ne .syslog_id "sudo") (ne .syslog_id "su") }}warning{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` [$__interval]))

spec.description:
Newest 1000 matching lines from `sudo`, `su` and the account tools, service accounts hidden by default.
- `info`: a command or `su` switch; `error`: a refusal or failed password; `warning`: an account change.
- The histogram above counts every match by the same levels, so the two disagree during a burst.

spec.expr: {hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"sudo|su|useradd|userdel|usermod|groupadd|groupdel|groupmod|gpasswd|passwd|chage|chpasswd|newusers|chsh|chfn"} |~ `$regexp` !~ `$sessions` !~ `$noservice` | label_format level=`{{ if or (contains " ; TTY=" __line__) (contains "authentication failure" __line__) (contains "could not identify password" __line__) (hasPrefix "FAILED SU" __line__) }}error{{ else if or (contains "COMMAND=" __line__) (hasPrefix "(to " __line__) }}info{{ else if and (ne .syslog_id "sudo") (ne .syslog_id "su") }}warning{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` | drop detected_level, transport, systemd_unit | line_format `[2mhostname={{.hostname}} syslog_id={{.syslog_id}}[0m {{__line__}}`

spec.title: su switches
spec.description: Successful `su` sessions. A `sudo su -` chain lands here *and* in **Sudo commands**.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id="su"} |~ `$regexp` |~ `^\(to ` | regexp `^\(to (?P<target>\S+)\) (?P<user>\S+) on ` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Account changes
spec.description: Changes logged by `useradd`, `usermod`, `userdel`, the `group*` tools, `gpasswd`, `passwd`, `chpasswd`, `chage`, `chsh` and `chfn`, one per change, not one per file the tool touched.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({hostname=~"$host", syslog_id=~"useradd|userdel|usermod|groupadd|groupdel|groupmod|gpasswd|passwd|chage|chpasswd|newusers|chsh|chfn"} |~ `$regexp` !~ `(shadow group|group added to /etc/|removed from /etc/|changed in /etc/gshadow|pam_unix\(passwd:|incorrect password|can't |Cannot determine|failed adding)` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Sudo

spec.name: service
spec.label: Service accounts
spec.description: Accounts that run `sudo` as a program rather than a person, as a regex alternation (`ansible|awx`). They are kept out of every audit panel and shown on the Service tab instead. Empty merges them back in.

spec.name: regexp
spec.label: Regexp
spec.description: Line filter applied to every panel. Matches are highlighted on the Logs tab.

spec.name: noservice
spec.label: Hide service
spec.description: Drop service-account command lines from the Logs tab. A link into the Logs tab turns this off.

spec.name: sessions
spec.label: Hide sessions
spec.description: Drop the `pam_unix(...:session)` open and close pairs from the Logs tab.
